name: lemlist
description: lemlist is a sales-engagement platform for multichannel campaigns, lead management, enrichment, personalization, inbox workflows, deliverability, and performance reporting.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned dedicated API key and one exact permanent cam_ campaign ID. Agents may read only the bound campaign's privacy-redacted name, status, creation time, and error-presence flag. Relay excludes creator/sender identity, mailboxes, leads, contacts, messages, replies, detailed errors, enrichment, AI, mutations, list/search queries, raw APIs, MCP, polling, bulk work, downloads, and exports.

capabilities.label: Read campaign status
capabilities.description: Read one bounded privacy-redacted status summary for the exact configured lemlist campaign ID.

approvalRequired.label: Read campaign status
approvalRequired.description: Read one bounded privacy-redacted status summary for the exact configured lemlist campaign ID.

blocked.label: Change campaigns
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, launching, pausing, archiving, scheduling, sequencing, or changing senders for campaigns is outside V1.

blocked.label: Access people or messages
blocked.description: Leads, contacts, email addresses, replies, inboxes, messages, sends, unsubscribes, and other person-level or communication data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run enrichment or AI
blocked.description: Enrichment, phone or LinkedIn discovery, data credits, research, personalization, and AI tools are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private account data
blocked.description: Creator and sender identity, mailboxes, teams, users, integrations, errors, labels, variables, CRM fields, detailed statistics, and raw responses are never returned.

blocked.label: Call raw or bulk surfaces
blocked.description: Raw REST, MCP, CLI, arbitrary endpoints, list/search/filter queries, pagination, polling, imports, exports, downloads, webhooks, API keys, and bulk work are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded private campaign status read requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected status read runs without Relay approval while exact campaign binding, fixed endpoint, audit, redaction, and response bounds remain enforced; people, messaging, enrichment, and writes stay blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated campaign status read and keeps the API key encrypted.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned lemlist account, dedicated API key, exact preconfigured campaign ID, plan/API access, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task create a dedicated API key, choose one preconfigured campaign, record its exact cam_ ID, store both through Relay, then validate Basic authentication, campaign binding, privacy redaction, approval/denial, key rotation/revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial without launching, changing, or messaging from the campaign.

evidence.supports: Official developer documentation requires HTTP Basic authentication with an empty username and API key as password.
Official overview documents the https://api.lemlist.com/api base URL and broad campaign, lead, performance, and hosted MCP surfaces.
Official reference documents fixed GET /api/campaigns/{campaignId} and campaign metadata including ID, name, creation time, status, creator, senders, team, and errors.
Official help documents separate integration API keys, one-time key visibility, renaming, deletion/revocation, and account/plan constraints.
Official hosted MCP setup supports OAuth or API-key access to broad lemlist tools; Relay does not mount this raw surface.
